parts.text: Which claim treats the list as a mathematical pattern?

options.text: Each term is double the one before, because we keep multiplying by 2.
The list looks neat, so it is a pattern with no rule needed.
Saying the doubling rule is what creates the cup counts.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A mathematical pattern needs a clear regularity and a reason it continues; here each term grows by doubling.

teacher.key_rationale: Doubling each time is both the regularity and the reason it continues. Neat looks alone omit the rule. Claiming the explanation creates the cup counts reverses the relation.
